fuel_info_text: Current Super E10 price of two stations, rated against the own price history of the last 7 days (cheap / normal / expensive), plus the usually cheapest time. Prices are fetched at most every 5 minutes with a random offset, as the Tankerkoenig terms require.
Please enter a valid API key: Please enter a valid API key
Please enter a valid station ID: Please enter a valid station ID
fuel_license_text: Fuel price data: Tankerkoenig (https://creativecommons.tankerkoenig.de), licensed under CC BY 4.0, source MTS-K.
easee_info_text: Reads the Easee chargers of your account via the Easee cloud and lets you start and stop charging. A separate Easee account for ioBroker (shared access to the chargers) is recommended. User name and password are stored encrypted.
30-600 s; Easee allows 100 requests per: 30-600 s; Easee allows 100 requests per 5 minutes
For the charging costs; 0 = no costs: For the charging costs; 0 = no costs
easee_command_text: Start/stop: write true or false to easee.chargerN.charge. Without RFID authorization the adapter uses pause/resume, with authorization start/stop.
Easee pushes changes at once; polling th: Easee pushes changes at once; polling then only runs every 5 minutes as a check
E-mail, or phone number with country cod: E-mail, or phone number with country code (e.g. +49...)
easee_charger_text: Only the chargers entered here are read and can be switched. Important if your account sees more chargers (e.g. as admin of a car park). Leave empty if the account has at most two chargers. The adapter log lists all names it finds.
Charger 1: name in the Easee app: Charger 1: name in the Easee app
Charger 2: name in the Easee app: Charger 2: name in the Easee app
ford_info_text: Reads your Ford vehicles with the official, read-only FordConnect Query API. Create an app for personal use in the Ford developer portal and enter its client ID and secret here. Use a separate FordPass account for ioBroker that has access to the vehicles.
Must be exactly the same as in the Ford: Must be exactly the same as in the Ford developer portal
5-60 minutes; frequent polling can get t: 5-60 minutes; frequent polling can get the account locked
ford_login_text: Login (once per vehicle, about once a year): after saving, open ford.vehicleN.login.url in the browser, log in with the FordPass account and pick the vehicle. The browser then shows an error page - copy its whole address into ford.vehicleN.login.response.
0 = electric / unknown; used for litres: 0 = electric / unknown; used for litres and consumption
Date like 2026-06-01; older sessions are: Date like 2026-06-01; older sessions are not loaded. Empty = all
notify_info_text: Short Telegram messages (text only): tank low while a station is cheap, charging finished or stopped by an error, electric car not plugged in in the evening, a tyre losing air. Each message comes once per event; a restart repeats nothing.
Telegram user names, separated by commas: Telegram user names, separated by commas. Empty: all users of the instance.
Fuel: tank low and price cheap: Fuel: tank low and price cheap
Charging finished or stopped by an error: Charging finished or stopped by an error
